## 🔒 Claimed — `domain:ui` execution seat (objectui)

- **Session:** `session_012wwHa4aaFybxXrfmfHioDM` · **Branch:** `claude/issue-7132-empty-state-convergence`
- **Build tier:** opus (⚠️ Fable 5 quota exhausted; the exemption lowers the *build* tier only)

### ✅ Unblocked — and by the mechanism this card was written to protect

This card exists because #7124's implementer identified changing `DataEmptyState`'s defaults as a **smaller** fix spanning both rulings, and **declined it**, because two agents designing one cross-surface abstraction in parallel is worse than two honest local fixes. Both local fixes have since landed (`eeb6c2f2b`, `220c18d05`).

⭐ **The fence held a second time, unprompted.** #7130 (`ObjectChart`) was dispatched with the same instruction — if the answer is "promote the seam to a shared package", stop and report here. Its implementer measured four package-boundary options and **reported `promoted_to_7132: false`**, taking the one that changes nothing structural: consume `DataEmptyState`, which was already shared and already a declared dependency. ⇒ Nothing has been pre-decided for this card by either sibling.

### ⚠️ It is now FIVE call sites, not four

PR #7139 (#7130) is in flight and adds `ObjectChart` as a **fifth** consumer of `DataEmptyState`, deliberately so that it *"collapses with the other four when #7132 converges the defaults."* ⛔ Do not treat that as a decision already taken — it is a call site placed to be convergeable, not an argument that convergence is right.

Measure on `main`, and account for #7139 landing during the work. ⛔ Do not edit `packages/plugin-charts` — that is its surface.

### The fences from the card, restated as binding

- ⛔ **Do not re-litigate #7063 or #7064.** Both ruled and landed. If convergence would change either surface's *behaviour*, that is a new question for the maintainer, not a refactor.
- ⛔ **Do not assume the answer is "hoist it into `DataEmptyState`".** That is the hypothesis this card tests, not its conclusion.
- ⛔ **Do not widen any authoring surface.** Both rulings closed the per-app-compensation route; adding an `emptyState` key to a new surface would reopen it one card later — and it is clause ②, needing a review the exhausted quota blocks. Built-but-unlandable, the state #6896 / PR #7111 has been in all session.
- ⭐ **"They legitimately differ, here is the evidence" is a FULL PASS.** Close it measured-and-declined and I will accept it as one. #7130 was dispatched on exactly those terms and its measurement is what turned a plausible decline into a warranted fix — the reverse outcome is equally valid.

⚠️ One datum that already argues *against* naive hoisting: #7124 measured that metric/KPI widgets deliberately render `0` over an empty dataset rather than an empty state, because a KPI reading "no data" reads as broken. `DatasetWidget.tsx:726-728` says so in the code. **At least one consumer family legitimately wants different behaviour.** Whether that generalises is what you are measuring.

## 🟢 Landed — `d1842abcf`

PR objectstack-ai/objectui#7144 merged; `main` advanced. `Fixes` closed this card.

### Verified by content with a differential control

| probe | pre (`dd35800af`) | post (`d1842abcf`) |
|---|---|---|
| `view-states.tsx` — **code** `role=` sites | 2 | **3** |
| `ListView.tsx` — `role="alert"` | 1 | **2** |
| CONTROL — `Data*` components in `view-states.tsx` | 3 | 3 ✅ |
| CONTROL — `DataEmptyState` in `ListView.tsx` | 3 | 4 ✅ |

The three new code sites are `:31` (`DataLoadingState`, pre-existing), `:130` (**the new `DataEmptyState` default**) and `:195` (`DataErrorState`, pre-existing) — so the file went from two of three siblings declaring a role to all three.

**⚠️ My own probe needed correcting first.** A line-count grep returned **6**, not the 3 I predicted, and I nearly recorded that as a discrepancy. Three of those six are inside the doc comment this PR added (`:90`, `:106`, `:109`) — the instrument was counting prose alongside implementation on a file the change deliberately documented. My prediction was right about the code; my measurement of it was not. Splitting code from comment is what made the reading true.

### Why this landed as-is

**Property 2 came back measured-and-DECLINED, and that is a full pass.** Self-describing default copy would be a change reaching every consumer plus an i18n project in a component with no translation hook, and every shipped surface already supplies its own copy. A card that converges one property and explicitly declines the other has answered its question.

**A naive hoist would have been actively harmful.** `plugin-list` renders its load *failure* through `DataEmptyState`, so a bare `role="status"` default would have announced a 403 as a routine status update. The correct convergence is **two lines, not one** — the default plus `role="alert"` at that call site. That is invisible to a source read: `view-states.tsx` shows one component missing one attribute and looks like a one-line fix. Only rendering the surfaces revealed that one of them was doing the other's job.

**My briefed consumer count was wrong and I verified the correction myself**: I said four call sites; it is **six in four packages**, seven with objectui#7139. `ListView.tsx` alone has two, and `packages/components`' own `ui:empty` renderer was never listed on the card.

Three of my assumptions were falsified and reported rather than absorbed — that `DataEmptyState` was the only shared empty-state primitive (`custom/empty.tsx` holds a whole second family), that all consumers pass compatible props, and the consumer count above. The KPI carve-out was confirmed but explicitly **non-generalising**: it is a branch gate on *whether* an empty state renders at all, upstream of this component.

### Follow-up now unblocked

**objectui#7143** — `ListView` renders its load failure through `DataEmptyState` while `DataErrorState` sits unused. This PR fixed the accessibility collision, not the structural one. Its file collision with this PR has cleared; its Clause ② fork has not.
